title: palcheck swallows the demos/juice.dem read error — a missing demo silently degrades the banner-rect oracle instead of failing setup
detail: A failed read is silently ignored (derr discarded); the gate then checks the banner border against a health-off y_base that may not match the blessed frame — a wrong expectation instead of the documented setup failure (exit 2).
recommended_fix: On derr != nil, print the error and return 2 (setup failure), same as the missing-goldens path directly above.

title: sprites.json bbox range check hard-codes the 256px canvas while ignoring the sidecar's res field
detail: The validator's bound is a literal 256, not the sidecar's res (and gen_sprites.py's RES is a parameter). A regenerated sheet with res<256 passes validation with bboxes beyond the actual texture — garbage src-window sampling.
recommended_fix: Parse the res field in sprites_parse_boxes and validate bboxes against it; reject res != the loaded textures' width.

title: bbox-to-texture mapping trusts the embedded order array with no cross-check against the hard-coded texture file list
detail: bboxes[i] is keyed by order[i] while textures[i] is keyed by the separate hard-coded files list; a renamed/reordered sidecar silently mis-crops sprites while passing every structural and range check.
recommended_fix: In sprites_parse_boxes, require order[i] == the expected files[i] name (or drive texture loading from the parsed order) so the two lists cannot diverge.
